headline: Instagram rolls out 90-minute videos, raising monetization questions
summary: Instagram is rolling out long-form videos of up to 90 minutes, a renewed push outlets frame as a direct challenge to YouTube and, per one report, an attempt to capture the broader short-clip economy too. A later report says Instagram has not laid out how, or whether, it will pay long-form video creators, prompting complaints from creators.
